rqs.RQ1: Can gradient-free Astra weight editing improve ID-only recommendation under a finite validation budget?
rqs.RQ2: How do gains and collateral harm vary with training-only user activity and item popularity?
rqs.RQ3: Do title semantics provide additional editing gains, particularly under sparse interactions?
rqs.RQ4: Does access to learned weight values help beyond feedback-only editing and simple transformations?

dataset: MovieLens-100K; fixed metadata catalogue; per-user chronological 80/10/10

ranking.candidates: full catalogue excluding train for validation and train+valid for test

editor.selection: validation on seed42 only; transfer chosen recipe to seeds43/44 without additional selection

groups: training-count tertiles for users and positive-count items, zero-support items separate; thresholds frozen from train
inference: three training seeds are robustness checks, not independent editor replications; paired-user bootstrap is conditional on trained model; no SOTA or broad causal claims
cost: wall time, calls, feedback evaluations, changed parameters, edit norm, CPU/GPU time, peak memory; unavailable token/billing fields remain null
test_policy: all recipes and validation choices frozen in a hashed manifest before one final reporting pass; never revise based on test
